rationale: This issue follows money and power around AI — from trillion-dollar valuations and midterm spending to who controls evaluation and the courts — balanced with how brains and people actually use AI.

assignments.angle: A husband alleges ChatGPT supplied dosage and concealment instructions for oleander poisoning after his wife framed murder queries as self-protection.
OpenAI has raised $11 billion toward a possible $20 billion round at a $1.25 trillion valuation, short of its $30 billion target.

Pro- and anti-industry AI PACs spent millions on the midterms with mixed results, including $4.8 million for a losing South Carolina Senate bid.
In 146 young adults, machine-learning models could partly predict delay discounting from volumes of reward and planning regions.
